Sophia — thanks for the options and the agenda. Quick clarification on timezones so we don't end up double-booked: when you say "10:00 BST / 11:00 CET" that's likely the same wall clock, but our EU attendees are on CET (Amsterdam team) and APAC are on SGT (Singapore). To make this unambiguous, could you confirm a single canonical time in UTC? For example: Thu Jul 22 09:00 UTC (which would be 10:00 BST / 11:00 CEST) versus Thu Jul 22 08:00 UTC (which maps to 16:00 SGT).

We have internal travel on Thu for Ben who needs to join the EU slot; if we keep a single meeting that spans both regions there's a risk Ben can't make the tail end. Two options from our side:

1) Single 60-min unified demo at Thu Jul 22 09:00 UTC — prefer if Liam can attend from Dublin.
2) Split into two 30-min sessions: EU-focused (Thu Jul 22 morning CET) and APAC-focused (Fri Jul 23 morning SGT).

If you can confirm which participants are essential (product decision-maker vs observers) we can move faster. I've tentatively blocked 09:00–10:00 UTC on Thu but can free it.

— Vivek
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
